newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Larsen plans $150 mln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: India's Larsen plans $150 mln debt issue.

text.p: Indian engineering and construction firm Larsen & Toubro Ltd plans a debt issue of about $150 million in the international market later this year, a top company official told Reuters on Friday.
"We have made an application to the finance ministry," Larsen & Toubro (L&T) member of the board and senior vice president (finance) Yeshwant Deosthalee said.
He said the issue is expected to be launched in the third or fourth quarter of this year. The lead manager to the issue has not been finalised, he said.
The funds would be used for capital expenditure.
"It will also be used to fund part of the equity which we will be required to take in BOO (build, own and operate) projects," Deosthalee said.

Bankers said L&T was among several applicants seeking to raise long-term funds to take advantage of the government's recent decision that loans of over 10-year duration would not be bound by the annual ceiling on external commercial borrowings.
